discordPostHtml:
Gives the pirates practically every ship/weapon/fighter/hullmod in your modlist.

Warning: Will completely, semi-irrevocably, undeniably destroy your intended game progression.

Warning 2: If the "assign default roles to ships that do not have them" setting is enabled, it will take anywhere from a little to a lot longer to start/load a campaign, depending on your modlist size.

Requires LunaLib

changelog.0.97:
Hopefully prevented a lot of crashes (if a crashing variant is still loaded, the fault is on the mod the variant is from for giving it a default role to begin with)
Fine-tuned the anti-module code some more (it isn't perfect but at this rate the things that get through might as well be normal ships)

Changed the version number from 0.96 to 0.97, wow!!!
